stack: TypeScript monorepo-in-one-package: pure engine/ core (zero platform imports) + web/ shell (Vite + React shell, raw DOM/rAF for the three lanes) + tools/ (Node-only ingest). Vitest.

sequencing.note: Lands ALONE. Clears four live repo traps that silently corrupt any branch taken before them.
Lands ALONE, ~half a day. Owns EVERY shared type plus the hand-authored fixtures. Closes judge risk R7 (untyped FrameState seam) and R8 (circular reference fixture).
Fully parallel. M5 runs the entire Phase B corpus campaign concurrently with all UI work.
Needs M3's channel vocabulary. Can start in wave 2 against fixtures/frame.reference.json.
Integrates. Also owns the headless session:dump that Phase D runs.

shared_contract.rule: Every arrow between modules is a TypeScript type, and every shared type is owned by M1. No module reaches around its interface. No module redefines a shared type.

fixtures.content: ~40 records covering all four pov stances, 2 multi-tagged records, and authored second variants so the center lane is servable before Phase B.
Person sidecar for corpus.mini.json. Satisfies persons[id][record.markers.pov] === record.text for every record.
A fixed UserConfig: 4 themes, no exclusions, operator on, 20 min, parallel mode.

HAND-AUTHORED SessionPlan for (corpus.mini, config.reference, seed=47). This is the SPECIFICATION, not an output. M2's job is to reproduce it byte-for-byte; M4's job is to render it. Neither agent waits on the other. Closes R8.
HAND-AUTHORED FrameState at three sample elapsedMs values (mid-head, mid-peak, mid-tail). Lets M4 be built and visually tuned before M2 computes a single step.

modules.name: M0
modules.title: repo-reset
modules.responsibility: Clear the four verified repo traps and lay a build spine that fails loudly. Lands alone, before anything else branches. Every trap below was re-verified live during Phase A synthesis; each one silently corrupts every other agent's work if still present when they branch.
acceptance: Hard-reset to origin/main. MEASURED: local main is 5 commits behind with rewritten SHAs, and the #66 spec does not exist in the working tree.

Delete assets/ (~4.5MB byte-identical duplicate of public/shaders), research/ (~40MB), ontologies/, hypnosis/, lib/pattern-compiler/, lib/session-engine/, src/, Next-era docs, Prisma/NextAuth residue, and the requirements.txt listing discord.py in a TypeScript SPA.
CI fails on failure. MEASURED: .github/workflows/ci.yml currently carries 5 continue-on-error:true steps; a green check is not a signal. Zero continue-on-error remain.
Lint rule: nothing under engine/ may import from web/, DOM types, window, fetch, Date.now, Math.random, or Node builtins. Rule fires in CI, tested against a deliberate violation fixture.
Lint rule: setInterval appears nowhere in the session path. MEASURED: src/routes/Player.tsx:75 drives playback from a hardcoded setInterval today.

Node-only firewall written down: tools/ has its own tsconfig.tools.json entry point and is EXCLUDED from the browser tsconfig include. MEASURED hazard: lib/pattern-compiler/loaders.ts:8 imports Node fs and calls process.cwd() at :34-35, and index.ts:112 re-exports it from the browser barrel.
hypnosis/modular/ removal is filed as its own issue noting the pre-existing GPLv2 + CC-BY-SA content inside an MIT repo, plus 17 files with no license header. Raised, not silently relabeled.
Deployment decision recorded: base path, router mode, SPA fallback for hard-refresh.

modules.name: M1
modules.title: corpus-schema + shared contract
modules.responsibility: Own EVERY type that crosses a module boundary, the stance derivation, the corpus loader/validator, and the five hand-authored fixtures. This module is the whole integration contract. It lands alone in ~half a day and everything else blocks on it.

exports: type PoolRecord, Markers, PersonTriple, Corpus, Provenance
interface.notes: Deliberately exports NO textToId function. Ids are opaque; MEASURED only 138/612 round-trip to a naive slug, so no code may reconstruct an id from text at read time.

acceptance: derivePov is the single definition of stance, and it is DERIVED from text rather than stored. The engine and the ingester each carry an implementation because the engine may not import from tools/; a test asserts the two agree on a shared case table, since a divergence fails every record of the disputed stance at load.
FrameState is fully typed here, not in M3. This is the seam that makes M2 and M4 parallelizable and it is owned by exactly one module.

Load-time validation: a record missing any person variant is DROPPED from the pool with a warning, never rendered. A record whose persons[id][derivePov(text)] !== record.text is a hard validation error.
Sidecar integrity invariant enforced at load: persons[record.id][derivePov(record.text)] === record.text for 100% of records.
pov enum is exactly first | second | named | impersonal. 'mixed' is deliberately not a value; MEASURED zero of 612 records need it.
All five fixtures are hand-authored and committed. plan.reference.json and frame.reference.json are specifications, NOT generated output — this is what decouples M2 from M4.
loadCorpus is pure and runs in Node with no browser shims.

modules.name: M2
modules.title: engine: planner + conductor
modules.responsibility: The core artifact and the largest module. Consent filters, theme-level block assembly, the shared theme walk, the Shuffler, gaussian titration, phase bookends, the person schedule with return-drift, parallel/unison modes, variable dwell and per-channel drift, SessionPlan construction, and the pure (plan, elapsedMs) -> FrameState conductor. Give this the strongest agent.

exports: plan(corpus: Corpus, config: UserConfig, opts: SessionOptions, seed: number): SessionPlan | PlanError[]
consumes: M1: Corpus, UserConfig, SessionOptions, SessionPlan, TripletTick, FrameState, Diagnostic, PlanError, CHANNEL_COUNT
interface.notes: Pure, synchronous, seeded. No clock of its own, no Math.random, no third-party imports, no DOM. Every SessionOptions tuning knob (PEAK_MIX, PIVOT_EVERY, THEME_HOLD, driftPct, dwell min/max, bell peak/width per axis) is a field, not a constant — so a bad sitting is a config change, not an engine rebuild.

acceptance: A1 Determinism: same (corpus, config, opts, seed) yields byte-identical SessionPlan across processes and runs.
Reproduces fixtures/plan.reference.json byte-for-byte from (corpus.mini, config.reference, seed=47). This is the integration test in a single file.
A2 Bookends: head + mid + tail === length for every length in 1..500. The upstream length<=2 overrun is clamped, not ported.
A3 Directionality: no emergence-theme mantra in the first 50% of any plan; no induction-theme mantra in the last 50%. 200 seeds x 10 configs. This is the 'Wide awake at line 2' regression test.
A4 Gaussian arc: per-step intensity trace is unimodal — non-decreasing to peak, non-increasing after — over 200 seeds.
A5 Triplet distinctness: in parallel mode all three mantraIds within a tick differ, every tick, every plan.
A6 Anti-repeat: no id repeats within a channel inside the shuffler window, except where a shuffler-degraded diagnostic is present. window = clamp(floor(blockSize/2), 3, 12).

A7 Consent: over 1000 random configs, zero mantras with has_operator when the toggle is off, and zero tagged with an excluded theme, checked against the record's FULL tag list rather than the bucket it was collected under. ZERO TOLERANCE — one violation blocks 1.0.
A8 Starvation is a plan error: unservable configs return PlanError[] naming the specific fix. No plan is ever returned with a missing or duplicate-filled tick.

A9 Person schedule: center is 'second' in 100% of ticks. Side 'named' share binned into deciles over 200 seeds is <0.20 in deciles 1-2, >0.55 in deciles 5-7, and <0.25 in deciles 9-10. NON-MONOTONE BY DESIGN — the return toward first person is asserted, not merely permitted.
A11 Performance: plan() p95 <= 40ms for a 500-step plan over the full corpus, asserted in CI.
A12 Diagnostics: every starvation, degradation and unison redraw appears typed in plan.diagnostics. Zero lane-starved on the reference config.
A13 Theme axis: exactly one theme is shared across all three lanes at every step, and the walk holds for THEME_HOLD steps between pivots.
C7 (engine half): a unison tick never resolves to an invariant mantra — the planner refuses and redraws.
Parity checklist DESIGN.md 4.11 rows 1-14 all pass headless, with no browser.

modules.name: M3
modules.title: triplet render model
modules.responsibility: The channel vocabulary: geometry, the v3-derived envelope/curve/ease semantics, WORD/LINE queue-drain split, alpha stratification, the .active gate, placeholder substitution with hardening, and inline pause markers. Describes what a frame LOOKS like, never when frames happen.

exports: renderChannel(tick: TripletTick, lane: LaneId, tInStepMs: number): ChannelFrame
substitute(template: string, names: {subject: string, operator: string}): string
parsePauseMarkers(text: string): Array<{text: string, holdMs: number}>
consumes: M1: TripletTick, FrameState, ChannelFrame, LaneId, Person
interface.notes: Deliberately does NOT depend on M2. FrameState is owned by M1, so M2 and M3 never negotiate a type.

acceptance: Geometry matches DESIGN.md 5.3: center scale 1.0 / alpha 1.0 / split LINE / offset +1000ms; sides scale 0.55 / alpha 0.30 / split WORD / offsets +500ms and 0ms.
WORD/LINE queue-drain: a 5-word mantra in WORD mode yields 5 tokens over 5 firings; in LINE mode one token. Same mechanism, one flag.
env in/hold/out produces a piecewise-linear alpha trapezoid with a TRUE absent tail — alpha is exactly 0 past the envelope, not a whole-clock triangle.
ease 'late' is p^3 (dwells at the start); ease 'early' is 1-(1-p)^3 (dwells at the end).
C6 Substitution never throws: any error falls back to returning the raw template. Property-tested against malformed inputs.
Format specs and conversions are REJECTED, not just unknown fields. '{subject:>4096}' must not render — it passes a naive format probe and then blows past output limits.
Exactly two placeholders are supported, bare form only: {subject} and {operator}. No {subject_subjective}, no [verb|verbs] — that grammar is a Phase B intermediate and never reaches runtime.
First letter is capitalized after substitution if lowercase, matching conditioner/utils/mantras.py:153-162.
Inline [500] and [1.5s] pause markers round-trip through the parser and hold the visual on a partial line.
Pure functions only: no DOM, no canvas, no timers. Fully unit-testable in Node.

modules.name: M4
modules.title: text renderer (the three lanes)
modules.responsibility: The only visual code that matters: paint three channels per FrameState with correct compositing, driven by a performance.now() rAF loop OUTSIDE React's reconciler. Owns the session clock, the pause-on-visibilitychange behavior, the threshold sequence and the exit sequence.

exports: mountSession(root: HTMLElement, plan: SessionPlan, hooks: {onEnd(): void, onProgress(p: number): void}): SessionHandle
type SessionHandle = { pause(): void; resume(): void; stop(): void; dispose(): void }
interface.notes: Can be built and visually tuned against fixtures/frame.reference.json before M2 exists. That is the strongest argument for the M2/M3 split.

acceptance: C8 Clock: elapsedMs comes from performance.now() inside a requestAnimationFrame loop. setInterval appears nowhere (lint-enforced by M0). Backgrounding the tab for 60s and returning produces NO burst of queued lines — the session pauses on visibilitychange and resumes on return.

C4 Performance: a 20-minute session sustains 60fps on a mid-range laptop with a flat heap at start vs end. The three lanes are written with raw DOM writes from the rAF loop, OUTSIDE React's reconciler — React never sits between the session clock and the pixels.
C1 Three channels render simultaneously with M3's geometry; the center is unambiguously dominant.
C2 The right channel visibly leads the center by ~1s and the stagger reads as intentional.
C3 (tuning observation, NOT a ship gate) Channels drift against each other over a full session. Recorded for the D7 sitting; driftPct is tunable to 0.

Threshold (DESIGN.md 6.5): Begin triggers darken 800ms -> bed fade-in 2s -> field 2s -> first center line. NO SPINNER — the plan, pool filtering, first variant resolution, font loading and shader compile all happen on the setup screen while the user reads their sample.
Exit (DESIGN.md 6.6): text stops, field and bed fade over 4s, black for 2s, then one low-contrast 'again · done' line. No stats, no score, no completion count, no share prompt.

C9 Accessibility: prefers-reduced-motion yields a WORKING static-field session (amplitude near zero, cross-fades 200ms, no parallax). Escape stops within 1.5s with a fade, never a cut. Every appearance/disappearance is a cross-fade >= 400ms.
The sides fade in at the head->middle transition and fade out at the middle->tail transition. The center is the thread held the whole way.

modules.name: M5
modules.title: corpus ingest + Phase B toolchain
modules.responsibility: The entire Phase B campaign: prompt assembly from the hand-tuned generation profiles, the grok batch runner, the validator/linter/conjugation gate, dedupe, id assignment, sidecar emission, and the per-tag coverage report. Node-only, TypeScript, importing M1's schema rather than reimplementing it.

exports: ingest(rawFiles: string[]): { pool, persons, provenance, report, reviewQueue }
interface.notes: TypeScript, not Python — one language on the critical path, one validator, one schema source of truth. Firewalled behind tsconfig.tools.json and NEVER imported by the browser bundle.

acceptance: B5 Idempotent: re-ingesting the same raw files produces a byte-identical pool. This is what makes Phase B resumable and its output reviewable as a diff.
Order-preserving: order within a block is NEVER sorted or shuffled at rest — the corpus is order-dependent (meter/rhyme adjacency). The ingester appends only.

B4 Conjugation gate passes with ZERO hard errors across L1 (agreement triple), L2 (copula/auxiliary closed set), L3 (bare-pronoun and stance checks). The machine-verified coverage percentage is printed in every report. MEASURED: the salvaged table holds 158 entries, 157 unique first-forms, with one conflicting 'have' pair that must be deduped (keep have|has|has) before use; it covers 61% of subject-governed tokens, so a naive every-verb check would carry a ~39% false-positive rate and must NOT be built.
Everything L1-L3 cannot confirm is routed to a review queue, never silently passed. The queue is triaged to zero before ship.
B8 Sidecar integrity: persons[id][record.markers.pov] === record.text emitted for 100% of records and asserted at emission.
B2 Every record carries all three person variants; invariant is COMPUTED (all three strings equal), never authored.
B3 pov is non-null on 100% of records and derived mechanically from the first variant's stance; no record is mixed-stance.
B6 Zero lint errors: placeholder validity, balanced braces, no trailing periods, no em/en dashes, no smart quotes, word count <= 20, GPT-ism blacklist.

Ids are assigned by conditioner's exact slug algorithm from scripts/migrate_mantra_pool.py:52-58, derived from the FIRST variant so ids stay stable if other variants are later edited. Ids are opaque thereafter.
B7 induction and emergence themes exist with >= 40 records each and are flagged hand-reviewed. These are authored FIRST (Tranche 0) because no exemplars exist for them anywhere in the ecosystem.
B9 Provenance emitted on every Phase B record; the original 612 carry source 'conditioner-pool' or 'human' and are never overwritten.
B1 Coverage report prints one count per tag against the >=54 floor (3 lanes x an 18-step peak dwell), so a tag that cannot field a lane is named before it reaches the picker.
grok is invoked headless single-turn via -p/--single with --json-schema constraining output to the contract shape — never by parsing prose for JSON.
Prompt contamination check: distinctive words (len >= 4, non-stopword) from the prompt leaking into generated mantras are reported per batch.
Firewall test: importing anything from tools/ in the browser bundle fails the build.

modules.name: M6
modules.title: backdrop + audio bed
modules.responsibility: The WebGL shader host with progress-driven uniforms, and the isochronic drone lifted from lib/drone.ts with its start/stop race fixed. Shares nothing with the engine but a progress float.

exports: mountBackdrop(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, shader: ShaderId): { setProgress(p: number): void; setPulseHz(hz: number): void; dispose(): void }
interface AudioBed { start(): void; stop(): void; setGain(db: number): void; dispose(): void }
interface.notes: Fully independent of the engine — depends only on M0. AudioBed is an interface with one implementation so a future Strudel bed is an implementation, not a refactor.

acceptance: Uses the existing GLSL shaders from public/shaders/. The byte-identical assets/ duplicate is deleted (M0) and the unrelated 2D-canvas spiral the running app currently uses is removed.
Uniforms (num_arms, rotation_speed, spiral_angle, pattern_speed, warp_speed) are driven by session progress through the same curve/ease vocabulary as the rest of the system.

The backdrop's transition rate is derived from the bed's pulse rate, so visuals and entrainment share one clock. Honors public/shaders/notes.md: sync transitions with the breathing cycle, visual fade to mask changes.

C9 Contrast: side lanes at 0.30 alpha clear 4.5:1 against the shader's BRIGHTEST frame. Tested by sampling max-luminance across a full uniform sweep. This is a real constraint on shader selection and must be honored at selection time, not retrofitted.
C9 Nothing in the field exceeds ~3Hz. No strobing, ever. prefers-reduced-motion drops field amplitude to near zero while the session still runs.
The drone.ts start/stop race at :117 is fixed on lift, with a regression test that starts and stops rapidly.
The frequency-independent 180-degree phase offset in the isochronic drone is preserved exactly.
The bed starts on the Begin user gesture, so autoplay-policy blocking is structurally impossible.
No Strudel. AGPL-3.0 against a public MIT repo (MEASURED isPrivate: false) is an unresolved licensing question and out of 1.0.

modules.name: M7
modules.title: shell, setup UI, and harness
modules.responsibility: The Configure screen with its live-feedback loop, the Play route, config persistence, presets, and the headless session:dump that makes the engine reviewable and that Phase D actually runs.

consumes: M1: Corpus, UserConfig, SessionOptions, SessionPlan, Diagnostic
interface.notes: session:dump is its own deliverable inside this module precisely because if the headless reader is nobody's job it does not get built — and it is the tool Phase D uses to verify the arc without sitting through 20 minutes.

acceptance: D3 Live-feedback loop: displayed counts equal what the plan actually contains. Shows 'your filters match N of M mantras', a per-tag breakdown warning when an exclusion drops an enrolled tag toward the floor, and two samples rendered as a LIVE TRIPLET with the user's own names — that sample is the first-run explanation, so no modal, no walkthrough, no tooltips.

Plan is rebuilt on every config change, debounced at 250ms, with errors and warnings surfaced inline. If A11's 40ms p95 budget is at risk, the typing path degrades to counts-only validation with the full plan built on blur and before Begin.
D4 A starving config is refused IN THE FORM with a message naming the specific fix ('drop sluttiness from your exclusions or re-enable operator mantras first'), never at playback.

Reject-don't-repair: a theme cannot be both enrolled and excluded, and THE SAVE BEING ATTEMPTED LOSES, mirrored in both directions so the outcome never depends on click order. An empty theme list is allowed — it is visible and simply blocks Start.
Excluded themes are a separate unbounded list, filtered against each mantra's FULL tag list rather than the bucket it was collected under.
Presets expand to explicit primitives BEFORE validation, so a preset can never carry hidden behavior. Unknown preset is a hard error. Three ship: standard, gentle, deep.
None of the Discord platform artifacts are inherited: no 25-option select cap, no alphabetical truncation, no 100-char labels, no 5-minute panel expiry. hypnoapp must not inherit 25 as a number.
D2 session:dump renders a SessionPlan to readable text, and a reviewer reading it confirms the arc: gentle open, build, peak, wean, wake. Prints diagnostics alongside.
D1 Configure -> Play -> a full 20-minute session completes unattended with no console errors.
D5 Deployed and reachable at a real URL, hard-refresh included — the SPA-fallback gap is closed.
D6 DESIGN.md lands in-repo under docs/ before implementation starts (required by issue #67).
Mode toggle (parallel / unison) is exposed and explained in one line; both are acceptance-tested paths, not one tested mode and one hedge.

coupling_summary.notes: M6 is fully independent of the engine. M2 and M3 never negotiate a type because M1 owns FrameState. M5 runs the whole Phase B campaign concurrently. The only convergence point is M7, which integrates already-specified functions.
